name: Werner Glock
original_name: ヴェルナー・グロック
source:
"I'm Werner Glock, president of Iris Corporation. It's important to live up to such a title, isn't it? My old company was Enigma. I wonder how they're holding up these days..."

The easygoing president of Iris Corporation. Like many others, he transferred from Enigma Corporation. He supposedly left due to a difficult coworker he just couldn't get along with.
He's very close with Chairwoman [url=/c160577]Iris[/url] and seems to know many secrets about this world, but he believes it's best not to talk about them, so he keeps his mouth shut.

Despite being laidback, he's actually a cautious and unpredictable man. Not exactly my type, honestly. Though he's pretty nice to [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url].

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category1&ch=glock]official website[/url]]
